thread:
morgan: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we observed a ledger skew during the delayed backfill window; some accounts received duplicate token rows and others had late writes that pushed invoices out by a day. need owners for: (1) recon csv, (2) staged credits, (3) a temporary backfill freeze, and (4) detection for recurrence.

sam: i'll take the freeze + backfill orchestration. plan: add a 'backfill_freeze' feature flag and a dry-run mode that reports diffs only. will open PR and include runbook. ETA Tue (2026-06-02).

asha: i'll own credits + customer comms. proposal: two-tranche credits: auto up to $50, manual review > $300. i'll draft CSV format and an email template. ETA Mon EOD (2026-06-01).

ellie-fin: finance needs CSV columns: invoice_id, account_id, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, credit_usd, reason_code. @asha tag me in the MET ticket when attached. we'll run an automated validation and then sign off.

billing-bot: Created MET-7302 "Ledger skew during backfill: reconciliation + credits" assignees: sam,asha due: 2026-06-10

infra-bot: Note: affected partitions: p3,p7,p9. Current backlog snapshot: 4.2M tokens. Recommend reduced parallelism for backfill to 2x for canary.

sam: useful query to surface likely duplicates (adjust time window as needed):

```
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(token_count) AS total_tokens, COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(inserted_at) AS first_seen, MAX(inserted_at) AS last_seen
FROM usage_ledger
WHERE source IN ('backfill-job','metering-consumer') AND inserted_at >= '2026-05-28'
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 OR SUM(token_count) > 75000
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 400;
```

morgan: action items summary:
- sam: backfill_freeze flag + dry-run + runbook (ETA 2026-06-02)
- asha: credits CSV + email template + attach to MET-7302 (ETA 2026-06-01)
- ellie-fin: validation & sign-off on credits (ETA 2026-06-03)
- sam + morgan: staged canary backfill with reduced parallelism + monitor (canary window 2h)

please ack and update MET-7302 when you start. keep customer-facing comms routed through @ellie-fin to avoid duplicate outreach.

asha: ack. drafting CSV now and will attach sample subset to MET-7302 in ~45m.

sam: ack. opening feature-flag PR and will include a script to pause/resume backfill.

ellie-fin: ack. will run cross-check against subscription billing and flag any credits > $1k for manual approval.

morgan: quick note on recurrence detection: include consumer restart timestamps, backfill parallelism, and partition-assign events in the RC doc so we can correlate with historical incidents. :memo:

billing-bot: Reminder: MET-7302 remediation sync scheduled Fri 09:30.

morgan: thanks all. keep updates short in the ticket and paste any query results (small sample) here if you need quick finance checks. :thumbsup:
